limitations: Input-unavailable/bounds flags partly define C29predictionU, so allknownfailure association is partly definitional; availability-only supplement remains explicit.
RawG42/role coordinate AUC reports larger raw value; no universal risk sign and no best-sign flip. Missing/degenerate placeholders masked.
Lowconfidence can reflect external occlusion or displacement; teacherD/E-conditioned position/failure tables and prospective E-vs-D target distinguish associations.
GTerror strata are diagnosis only, never a deployed filter/U rule or coordinate correction.
